g.text: Finite 900 L tank: actual cooling, pressure loss and gas discharge
Matched flat ground: initial CG 0.592 m; 350 bar / 293.15 K; adiabatic finite gas; 20 kN per main nozzle unchanged.
3.12 refuses this same initial state for predicted impulse shortfall, so it has no execution curve. All accepted runs retain real return/landing dynamics.
